crewNotes.text: General Egypt traveller allowances; crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with the Egyptian Customs Authority. Compiled from the cited guidance, pending final authority review.

rules.text: One litre of spirits is permitted on arrival. In addition, tourists may buy up to 3 litres of spirits from a duty-free shop within 48 hours of arrival (reduced duty on the first two litres).

declarationRequirements.text: New personal goods and gifts up to EGP 15,000 in value are exempt for tourists and returning residents; higher-value goods are subject to duty.

rules.text: One carton of 200 cigarettes, or 25 cigars, or 200g of tobacco.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
